note.en: Every national highway in the country, each drawn as the Ministry's own survey holds it: 124,000 km of it, with the 35 that are told by name picked out over the rest. A highway's number is in the source, so a card and its course are the same road by construction and not by a guess at where it runs.
note.hi: देश का हर राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग, मंत्रालय के अपने सर्वेक्षण के अनुसार खिंचा: कुल 1,24,000 किमी, जिनमें से 35 नाम और कथा सहित बाक़ी के ऊपर उभारे गए हैं। राजमार्ग का क्रमांक स्रोत में ही है, इसलिए कार्ड और उसकी रेखा एक ही सड़क हैं — अनुमान से नहीं, रचना से।

attribution: Highway centrelines: the national highway network published by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways through PM GatiShakti, republished as GeoJSON by INDIAN-SHAPEFILES. Every feature carries its highway number, so a named item joins its geometry by that number; the unnamed network item is everything no item has claimed. Facts checked against the Ministry's own list of primary national highways and Wikipedia.
_join: The source has geometry but no names, so an item lists the places its route is known by and the build walks the source's own parts between them.
_rank: 1 is a trunk route drawn widest, 3 a short one drawn finest; the engine reads rank, never a road's number.
